title: Penicillin made in the United States, 1943–1949 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale, in billions of units of penicillin made in the United States in a year: 1943, 21; 1944, 1,663; 1945, more than 6,800; 1949, 133,229. Data: American Chemical Society, The Discovery and Development of Penicillin 1928–1945, an International Historic Chemical Landmark (1999).
